summary: Master Supply Chain Data Analytics and Control Towers to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and reduce costs through real-time dashboards and predictive analy
lede: Supply chain analytics uses operational data to support decisions about demand, inventory and logistics. This course is for supply chain analysts, planners, logistics managers and control tower operators who need to monitor performance and respond to changing conditions. It covers KPI design and dashboard building, demand forecasting, and using control tower alerts and optimization models to identify risks and guide inventory or logistics decisions.

prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of Excel (pivot tables, basic formulas) and familiarity with SQL concepts (SELECT, JOIN). No Python coding expertise required—exercises use pre-built templates and guided scripts. Tools to Install: Participants should bring a laptop with Power BI Desktop (free) and Tableau Public (free) installed, or use cloud-based versions provided during training. Sample supply chain datasets will be provided for exercises.
